question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental core `claws update` planning and plan-integrity contract as the supported foundation for the stacked update-apply workflow?
rationale: This is a new core lifecycle CLI and consent model, not a repair to an established behavior; the follow-on mutation PR depends on its plan schema and security semantics.

options.title: Sponsor the staged core contract
options.body: Approve the read-only planner as the experimental core foundation after current-tree lifecycle proof is posted, then review the apply slice separately.

options.title: Keep lifecycle packaging outside core
options.body: Decline the core contract and redirect the capability toward an external plugin or package workflow if the repository should not own grouped Claw lifecycle state.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged core contract
recommendation.body: Approve the read-only planner as the experimental core foundation after current-tree lifecycle proof is posted, then review the apply slice separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is assigned and has already reviewed the planner’s authoritative lifecycle and ownership boundaries.
